company.name: Alixia
company.shortDescription: Alixia is a medical research company that engages in developing new modalities to treat cancer, aging, and inflammation.
company.description:
In its quest to develop new ways to fight cancer, aging, and inflammation, Alixia is engaged in medical research. The company utilizes integrate
biology, biophysics, computational chemistry, and clinical inputs to drive
new therapeutic innovations. The company's lead compounds focus on lead compounds that disrupt the metabolic and inflammatory triggers in both cancer and quasi-cancerous cells in the microenvironment.

productsAndServices.description: Compounds designed to disrupt metabolic and inflammatory triggers in cancer and related cells within the tumor microenvironment to inhibit tumor growth.
productsAndServices.name: Tumor Ecosystem Disruptors

productsAndServices.description: Preclinical programs targeting diseases related to cancer, aging, neurodegeneration, inflammation, and immune dysregulation.
